GamesJust Dance: Decades of Hits - Limited EditionVersionNintendo SwitchSelect an editionDigital - Just Dance: Decades of Hits - Limited EditionMild LyricsUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingNintendo Switch 2 Compatibility InformationSupported – Game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch. IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADESEach decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWSCelebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan favorites like:- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo Ft. Don Omar- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls- "No Scrubs" by TLC- "It's Tricky" by Run-D.M.C- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel- "Mamma Mia" by ABBAAND MORE!From easy-to-follow to satisfyingly challenging, this year's tracklist is made to get players of all ages and styles dancing together!DISCOVER A FUN ADVENTURE FOR ALL GENERATIONSExplore the decades together in the new Adventure Mode. Discover 6 themed worlds, dance to iconic songs, enjoy fun mini-activities, and unlock exclusive rewards. Only available with Just Dance: Decades of Hits!ENDLESS WAYS TO PARTYDance with up to 6 players locally, jump into Party Mode, or get moving with Workout Mode. Grab your friends and family, choose your mode or dance, and let the party begin!Software description provided by the publisher.Bundle includes the following:For details on the products in this bundle, including up-to-date system compatibility information, please refer to each product page listed below.Just Dance Free ExperienceGamesJust Dance: Decades of Hits – 2000s Cosmetic PackGamesRelated tagsMusicPartyMotion controlsOnline scoreboardsPlay for a high scoreCompete onlineCross-platform playMeet up and play togetherPlay together on one consoleShow moreAbout this itemSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite. Additional accessories may be required(sold separately). See support for details.No. of playersSingle system (1-6)Online (1-6)Nintendo Switch OnlineOnline PlaySave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
